title: Food drive this Saturday
body: We are collecting non-perishables for the community pantry from 10am. Bring what you can to the Fellowship Hall - and stay for coffee.

title: Camp registration closes soon
body: Summer camp sign-ups close at the end of next week. If your child is coming, please register so we can finalise transport and catering.

title: Staff meeting moved to Wednesday
body: This week only - the Tuesday staff meeting moves to Wednesday 9am so we can be at the school assembly.
